### What does this PR do?

Fixes #7398 by deriving the default number of TransferQueue `SimpleStorage` units from `trainer.nnodes`. When the configured value is null, resolve it to `max(2, 2 * trainer.nnodes)` immediately before TransferQueue initialization; preserve any explicit `num_data_storage_units` override.

The original fixed default reserves eight storage-unit CPUs plus the controller even for a single-node run. This change follows the config's existing recommendation of at least two units per node and reduces the one-node default to two.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+num_data_storage_units+SimpleStorage
- [x] Also checked `7398 in:body`, `TransferQueue CPU storage units`, and `SimpleStorage cluster size`; no overlapping PR was found. PR #6663 adds a separate fail-fast check for training placement groups and does not change TransferQueue's storage-unit count.
- [x] PR title follows the required format.

### Test

Rebased onto upstream `main` at `5eb4826694f35d8453ad465b67e3e02cb6b34f07`, retaining the TransferQueue v0.1.11 schema updates from #8181, including unlimited capacity, SSD offload, and Mooncake defaults.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/home/liuhao/verl-worktrees/issue-7398-transferqueue-refresh PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project /home/liuhao/verl --no-sync python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/utils/test_config_on_cpu.py
# 5 passed, 2 pre-existing collection warnings

PYTHONPATH=/home/liuhao/verl-worktrees/issue-7398-transferqueue-refresh PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project /home/liuhao/verl --no-sync python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/utils/test_config_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_config_router_replay_on_cpu.py tests/trainer/ppo/test_score_centering_on_cpu.py -k 'config or settings or off or misconfigurations'
# 20 passed, 34 deselected

PATH=/home/liuhao/verl/.venv/bin:$PATH bash scripts/generate_trainer_config.sh
# All good; regenerated all four PPO config references

PATH=/home/liuhao/verl/.venv/bin:$PATH pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=never
# All hooks passed
```

Actual Hydra composition verified 24 cases across `dp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, and `torchtitan`: the defaults for 1/2/4/8 nodes resolve to 2/4/8/16 units, and explicit values 5 and 8 remain unchanged. All other TransferQueue configuration fields match the composed base config, including SSD offload and Mooncake settings. These are CPU configuration checks, not multi-node training experiments.

### API and Usage Example

The existing explicit override remains unchanged:

```bash
transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units=5
```

Leaving the value at null selects `max(2, 2 * trainer.nnodes)`.

TransferQueue checkpoints must be restored with the same storage-unit count used when they were written. A single-node checkpoint written with the previous implicit default of 8 units must be resumed with this explicit override:

```bash
transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units=8
```

Preserve the original count explicitly when changing `trainer.nnodes` for a resumed run.

### Design & Code Changes

- Change the SimpleStorage YAML default from 8 to null and regenerate all flattened PPO trainer configs.
- Resolve the node-aware default before printing the runtime config and before `tq.init`.
- Preserve explicit values and add CPU coverage for one-node, multi-node, and override behavior.

### Compatibility

This changes the implicit default: one-node runs use 2 storage units instead of 8, and four-node runs use 8. Explicit values are unchanged. Because storage-unit count is part of TransferQueue checkpoint recovery, users must pass the checkpoint's original count when resuming a checkpoint created under the previous implicit default.

### AI assistance disclosure

OpenAI Codex assisted with issue triage and implementation. The human submitter reviewed the changed lines and verified the behavior and tests before opening this PR.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
- [x] Applied `pre-commit run --all-files` after the latest rebase; all hooks passed.
- [x] Added CPU unit tests.
- [x] Updated generated configuration references.
- [x] Documented the TransferQueue checkpoint recovery requirement and marked the PR breaking.
- [x] Human submitter reviewed the implementation and ran the relevant tests before initial submission.
- [ ] Request upstream CI after the PR is ready.

 from verl.base_config import BaseConfig

+from verl.utils.config import resolve_transfer_queue_config
 
 
 @dataclass
@@ -93,5 +94,33 @@ def test_command_with_override(self):
         self.assertIn("profiler", result.stdout)
 
 
+class TestTransferQueueConfigOnCPU(unittest.TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _config(nnodes, num_data_storage_units=None):
+        return OmegaConf.create(
+            {
+                "trainer": {"nnodes": nnodes},
+                "transfer_queue": {"backend": {"SimpleStorage": {"num_data_storage_units": num_data_storage_units}}},
+            }
+        )
+
+    def test_storage_units_default_scales_with_nodes(self):
+        single_node_config = self._config(nnodes=1)
+        multi_node_config = self._config(nnodes=4)
+
+        resolve_transfer_queue_config(single_node_config)
+        resolve_transfer_queue_config(multi_node_config)
+
+        self.assertEqual(single_node_config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(multi_node_config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units, 8)
+
+    def test_storage_units_explicit_override_is_preserved(self):
+        config = self._config(nnodes=4, num_data_storage_units=3)
+
+        resolve_transfer_queue_config(config)
+
+        self.assertEqual(config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units, 3)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

+def resolve_transfer_queue_config(config: DictConfig) -> None:
+    """Resolve node-dependent defaults before initializing TransferQueue."""
+    simple_storage = config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage
+    if simple_storage.num_data_storage_units is None:
